question: Select the most appropriate antonym of the word: **Venerate**
solution:
The correct answer is: **2 i.e. Despise**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Venerate"** means to regard someone or something with great respect or reverence. (सम्मान करना)
 
 
• **Example:** Many cultures venerate their elders as a source of wisdom and guidance.
 
 
• **"Despise"** refers to feeling a strong dislike or lack of respect for someone or something. (घृणा करना)
 
 
• **Example:** She despises dishonesty and always expects people to be truthful.
 
 
• Since "Despise" is the opposite of "Venerate," it is the correct antonym.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **2 i.e. Despise**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Honor** (सम्मान): High respect or great esteem.
 
 
• **Example:** The soldier was honored for his bravery in battle.
 
 
 
• **Respect** (आदर): A feeling of deep admiration for someone or something.
 
 
• **Example:** Students should always show respect towards their teachers.
 
 
 
• **Admire** (प्रशंसा करना): To regard someone or something with respect and approval.
 
 
• **Example:** I truly admire her dedication to her work.
 
 

43:T8b6,

The correct answer is: **Option 2 i.e. Nostalgia**.
